description:
Singer-songwriter Stephen Wilson Jr. reflects on his father's influence on his own career
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Stephen Wilson Jr. talks about how much his father influences his decision to sing his own songs. “He saw a lot more in me than I ever saw in myself,” Wilson Jr. says. “And when he died, I made that whole record for him.” The record Wilson Jr. is talking about is called “søn of dad,” a 22-song collection he describes as a “sonic monument” to his late father. 

Stephen Wilson Jr. was Zach McCormick's guest on The Current's July 31, 2026, episode of Tonal Recall, the show that celebrates the music and culture of the 1990s. Find the full interview with Stephen Wilson Jr. here: https://youtu.be/5VhaMOoMaDs
